The '''Al'Nasrl sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], there was believed to be a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] cell building in the sector, and [[Murtan Andes]] of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] was directed to dismantle the [[Tatooine/3]] [[system cell]] and take essential personnel to the Al'Nasrl sector.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
